# Data preparation

## installing packages

```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("psych")
install.packages("tidyr")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("ggalluvial")
install.packages("flextable")
```

## loading packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(flextable)
```

## loading data

```{r}
dat <- read_csv2("../Data/z-prosoData_VHUNZIKER_v2.csv")

```

## selecting variables

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(K7_21:K7_Opti, #Well-being
                K8_21:K8_Opti,
                K9_21:K9_Opti,
                K7_651:K7_659, #internalizing symptoms Items... aber nicht vollständige Items des SBQ, die für Imputation von KX_nSBQ_ANXDEP verwendet wurden
                K8_653:K8_659,
                K9_652:K9_656, K9_658:K9_659,
                K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP, K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP, K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP, # Score Anxdep
                K7_402:K7_ResilFriends, # Peer Support
                K7_1101:K7_1105, K7_BullVict4, #bullying victimization
                K8_1101:K8_1105, K8_BullVict4,
                K5_102, K9_102, K9_102o,ADR_GenderChild, # sex/gender
                K7_5000, K8_5000, K9_5000, # sexual attraction
                'K5#6_ISEImax' #SES
                )


                
```

### Personen ID erstellen

```{r}
# create Person-ID
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(person_id = row_number()) %>%
  relocate(person_id, .before = 1)

# Check if it has worked or any one is doubled
nrow(dat)
n_distinct(dat$person_id)
anyDuplicated(dat$person_id)

```

# Missing values

```{r}
# all Values (-1,9,90,99) should be treated as NA except for person_id 90 in the variable SES
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(
    -c(person_id, `K5#6_ISEImax`),
    ~ replace(., . %in% c(-1, 9, 90, 99), NA)
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    `K5#6_ISEImax` = replace(
      `K5#6_ISEImax`,
      `K5#6_ISEImax` %in% c(-1, 9, 99), NA)
  )


```

# Missingness

```{r}
# Missingness of analysis variables 
missing_table <- tibble(
  construct = c(
    "Well-being", "Well-being", "Well-being",
    "Internalizing", "Internalizing", "Internalizing",
    "Sexual orientation", "Sexual orientation", "Sexual orientation",
    "Peer support",
    "Bullying victimization", "Bullying victimization",
    "Gender",
    "SES"
  ),

  wave = c(
    "K7", "K8", "K9",
    "K7", "K8", "K9",
    "K7", "K8", "K9",
    "K7",
    "K7", "K8",
    "Baseline",
    "K5/6"
  ),

  variable = c(
    "K7_Opti", "K8_Opti", "K9_Opti",
    "K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP", "K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP", "K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP",
    "K7_5000", "K8_5000", "K9_5000",
    "K7_ResilFriends",
    "K7_BullVict4", "K8_BullVict4",
    "ADR_GenderChild",
    "K5#6_ISEImax"
  )
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    N_total = nrow(dat),
    N_available = sum(!is.na(dat[[variable]])),
    N_missing = sum(is.na(dat[[variable]])),
    Percent_missing = round(N_missing / N_total * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

missing_table


# Longitudinal missingness pattern: Well-being
wb_missing_patterns <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    K7 = if_else(is.na(K7_Opti), "Missing", "Available"),
    K8 = if_else(is.na(K8_Opti), "Missing", "Available"),
    K9 = if_else(is.na(K9_Opti), "Missing", "Available")
  ) %>%
  count(K7, K8, K9) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

wb_missing_patterns

# Missings of internalizing over the three waves 
int_missing_patterns <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    K7 = if_else(is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP), "Missing", "Available"),
    K8 = if_else(is.na(K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP), "Missing", "Available"),
    K9 = if_else(is.na(K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP), "Missing", "Available")
  ) %>%
  count(K7, K8, K9) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

int_missing_patterns
```

# Classification Sexual Orientation 

```{r}
# Classification Sexual orientation 
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_k7 = case_when(
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K7_5000 == 5 ~ "Heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K7_5000 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K7_5000 %in% 1:4 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K7_5000 %in% 2:5 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    orientation_k8 = case_when(
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K8_5000 == 5 ~ "Heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K8_5000 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K8_5000 %in% 1:4 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K8_5000 %in% 2:5 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    orientation_k9 = case_when(
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K9_5000 == 5 ~ "Heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K9_5000 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K9_5000 %in% 1:4 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K9_5000 %in% 2:5 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# define reference group
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_k7 = factor(
      orientation_k7,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    ),
    orientation_k8 = factor(
      orientation_k8,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    ),
    orientation_k9 = factor(
      orientation_k9,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    )
  )
```

# Attrition Analysis

```{r}
# subdataset for attrition Analysis
dat_selection <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    selection_status = if_else(
      !is.na(orientation_k9),
      "Included",
      "Excluded"
    )
  )

# compare different baseline characteristica -> do participants who weren't there anymore at K9 different at K7 from the people who stayed
selection_table <- dat_selection %>%
  group_by(selection_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    wb_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                    mean(K7_Opti, na.rm = TRUE),
                    sd(K7_Opti, na.rm = TRUE)),

    int_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                     mean(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP, na.rm = TRUE),
                     sd(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP, na.rm = TRUE)),

    peer_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                      mean(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE),
                      sd(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE)),

    bullying_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(K7_BullVict4, na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(K7_BullVict4, na.rm = TRUE)),

    ses = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                  mean(`K5#6_ISEImax`, na.rm = TRUE),
                  sd(`K5#6_ISEImax`, na.rm = TRUE)),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -selection_status,
    names_to = "Characteristic",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = selection_status,
    values_from = Value
  )

selection_table ### -> SES unterscheidet sich zwischen Excluded und Included
```

```{r}
       is.na(K7_5000) & !is.na(K8_5000) & !is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K8_K9",
       is.na(K7_5000) & !is.na(K8_5000) &  is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K8_only",

    )
  )

table(dat$sexor_pattern)

table(dat$orientation_k8, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat$orientation_k9, useNA = "ifany")

table(dat$orientation_k8, dat$orientation_k9, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat$orientation_k7, dat$orientation_k9, useNA = "ifany")

## Who has changed classification over the course of three waves at least once? 
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_change = case_when(
      
      # all three waves there and classification stayed identical
      !is.na(orientation_k7) &
      !is.na(orientation_k8) &
      !is.na(orientation_k9) &
      orientation_k7 == orientation_k8 &
      orientation_k8 == orientation_k9 ~ "No change",
      
      # all three waves there and classification changed
      !is.na(orientation_k7) &
      !is.na(orientation_k8) &
      !is.na(orientation_k9) ~ "Change",
      
      # not all three waves theren
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
```

```{r}
ses_desc <- dat_eligible %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`)),
    Missing = sum(is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`)),
    M = round(mean(`K5#6_ISEImax`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD = round(sd(`K5#6_ISEImax`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),

ses_desc

# Sexual Orientation  -> DAT VERWENDEN, WEIL ALLE PERSONEN EINGESCHLOSSEN WERDEN HIERFÜR...
# TABLE 1 UND 2
# Table1 -> how many participants can be categorized in each wave 
tab1 <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(c(orientation_k7, orientation_k8, orientation_k9),
               names_to = "wave", values_to = "orientation") %>%
  mutate(wave = toupper(sub("orientation_", "", wave)),
         orientation = as.character(orientation)) %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  summarise(het = sum(orientation == "Heterosexual", na.rm = TRUE),
            non = sum(orientation == "Non-heterosexual", na.rm = TRUE),
            Missing = sum(is.na(orientation)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(valid = het + non,
         `Heterosexual, n (%)`     = paste0(het, " (", round(het / valid * 100, 1), ")"),
         `Non-heterosexual, n (%)` = paste0(non, " (", round(non / valid * 100, 1), ")")) %>%
  select(Wave = wave, `Heterosexual, n (%)`, `Non-heterosexual, n (%)`, Missing)

tab1
# Table 2 Change of classification between the waves
trans_tab <- function(from, to, label) {
  dat %>%
    filter(!is.na({{ from }}), !is.na({{ to }})) %>%
    group_by(start = {{ from }}) %>%
    summarise(N = n(),
              same = sum({{ from }} == {{ to }}),
              changed = sum({{ from }} != {{ to }}), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Comparison = label,
           `Stayed, n (%)`  = paste0(same, " (", round(same / N * 100, 1), ")"),
           `Changed, n (%)` = paste0(changed, " (", round(changed / N * 100, 1), ")")) %>%
    select(Comparison, `Classification at start` = start, N,
           `Stayed, n (%)`, `Changed, n (%)`)
}
tab2 <- bind_rows(
  trans_tab(orientation_k7, orientation_k8, "K7 to K8"),
  trans_tab(orientation_k8, orientation_k9, "K8 to K9"),
  trans_tab(orientation_k7, orientation_k9, "K7 to K9")
)

tab2
save_as_docx("Table 1" = flextable(tab1) %>% autofit(),
             "Table 2" = flextable(tab2) %>% autofit(),
             path = "tabellen_orientation.docx")
```

## Univariate description

```{r}
descriptive_table <- tibble(
  construct = c(
    "Well-being",
    "Well-being",
    "Well-being",
    "Internalizing symptoms",
    "Internalizing symptoms",
    "Internalizing symptoms",
    "Peer support",
    "Bullying victimization",
    "Bullying victimization",
    "SES"
  ),
  
  wave = c(
    "K7",
    "K8",
    "K9",
    "K7",
    "K8",
    "K9",
    "K7",
    "K7",
    "K8",
    "K5/6"
  ),
  
  variable = c(
    "K7_Opti",
    "K8_Opti",
    "K9_Opti",
    "K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP",  
    "K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP",   
    "K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP",   
    "K7_ResilFriends",
    "K7_BullVict4",
    "K8_BullVict4",
    "K5#6_ISEImax"
  )
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    N = sum(!is.na(dat_eligible[[variable]])),
    
    M = round(
      mean(dat_eligible[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      2
    ),
    
    SD = round(
      sd(dat_eligible[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      2
    ),
    
    Median = round(
      median(dat_eligible[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      2
    ),
    
    Min = round(
      min(dat_eligible[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      2
    ),
    
    Max = round(
      max(dat_eligible[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      2
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

descriptive_table
```

## Mental Health at each wave seperated for SMY und HMY

```{r}
# Wellbeing
wellbeing_summary <- dat_long %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(wellbeing),
    !is.na(K9_orientation)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, K9_orientation) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    M = round(mean(wellbeing), 2),
    SD = round(sd(wellbeing), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
wellbeing_summary

# internalizing
internalizing_summary <- dat_long %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(internalizing),
    !is.na(K9_orientation)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, K9_orientation) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    M = mean(internalizing),
    SD = sd(internalizing),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
internalizing_summary
```

### Plot of mental health over the course of time

```{r}
# Plot internalizing over time separated for SMY and HMY
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.25)

p <- ggplot(
  wellbeing_summary,
  aes(
    x = wave,
    y = M,
    group = K9_orientation,
    linetype = K9_orientation,
    shape = K9_orientation
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, position = pd) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, position = pd) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = M - SD, ymax = M + SD),
    width = 0.1,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    linetype = "solid",   
    position = pd
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Assessment wave",
    y = "Wellbeing (M ± SD)",
    linetype = "Sexual orientation",
    shape = "Sexual orientation"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm")  
  )

p
```
